title: The Arrow Lands in the Mud
skyStory: The waning gibbous moon, seventy-three percent lit, moves into Sagittarius and immediately wants an adventure. It fires an arrow toward the horizon, full of optimism. The arrow lands, with a deeply unglamorous squelch, in a big patch of mud. Welcome to mud season. Jupiter, Sagittarius's ruler, laughs so hard its rings wobble. Adventure, it says, always starts a little messy.

reading: Mud season is here, and it is a perfect metaphor for your week: nothing is clean, everything is moving, and the boots are definitely ruined. This is good. Messy movement beats tidy stillness every time. The Tiger does not mind muddy paws.

Something you start today will look clumsy at first. Let it. The first draft of anything looks like an arrow in the mud. The [[Knight of Wands]] rides through puddles without slowing down, because the destination matters more than the splash. Aim at one thing and keep going. By April, the mud will have dried into a path.
joel.mission: Start one thing today badly on purpose, a messy draft or a rough sketch, and refuse to fix it until tomorrow.
joel.omen: Muddy footprints leading somewhere new. It means your messy start is actually headed in exactly the right direction.

reading: Sagittarius moons make everyone want to wander, and you will catch the itch too. Not a big trip. A small one. A new trail, a different coffee shop, a street you have never walked down. The shore is lovely in mud season if you wear the right boots.

Around 1:15 pm a stranger will ask you for directions, or you will overhear someone describing a place you have never been. Take note. That is the Sagittarius moon slipping you an invitation. Your onyx bracelet will feel extra steady on your wrist, reminding you that wandering is safe when you have strong roots. Go see something new.
nancy.mission: Walk down one street, trail or hallway you have never explored, and find one thing worth telling Joel about.
nancy.omen: A stranger asking for directions. It means an adventure is knocking, and you are invited.

together.text: Mud season expedition. Each of you go somewhere new, even tiny, and send the other a photo of your muddiest boot or step. The muddiest photo is declared the bravest explorer. Jupiter is the official judge and loves a mess.
